common.local_provider_busy: Wait for the current check to finish, then try again.
common.local_provider_settings_help: Match the port in your local server settings. Changes apply to new sessions.
common.local_provider_saved_refresh: Port saved. Refresh to check the server again.
common.projects.first_message: Choose a folder to start chats, run agents, and keep your work together.
common.chat.fast_mode_select_grok: Select a Grok model with an available fast variant. Refresh the model list to check availability.
common.chat.fast_mode_grok_help: Uses this model’s fast variant for faster output at higher cost. It can use your subscription allowance faster. Availability depends on the model and your account.
common.chat.fast_mode_grok_next_turn_hel: Speed applies when the next turn starts. Finish or stop the current turn before switching.
common.chat.fast_mode_select_opus: Select a supported Opus model to use fast mode. Faster responses use paid usage credits, even when your plan has usage remaining.
common.chat.fast_mode_codex_help: Faster responses where available. Uses subscription limits faster and costs more when billed by credits or API tokens. You may reach your usage limit sooner. Speed depends on the model and your account.
common.chat.fast_mode_claude_help: Faster Opus responses where available. Uses paid usage credits, even when your plan has usage remaining, or higher API pricing. Availability depends on your account. Enabling it mid-conversation can cost more.
common.chat.fast_mode_live_help: You can switch while the agent works. The next model request uses the new speed; requests already in progress keep their current speed.
common.chat.fast_mode_next_turn_help: This CLI version applies speed when the next turn starts. Update the CLI to switch during a turn.
common.chat_original_pending: The original message stays in Pending for a delivery check. You can write a new message.
common.chat_routing_enabled: Continue with another agent when usage runs out
common.chat_return_preferred: Return to the preferred model after reset
common.chat_route_unavailable: Update the repository’s computer to use routing.
common.chat_route_delivery: Continuation delivery needs checking. You can write a new message.
common.chat_route_explanation: The next agent receives the conversation and workspace context. Routing keeps this chat’s permissions.
common.chat_files_relay_message: Transfer %1$@ (%2$@) through the relay? Uploads, downloads and retries use your account’s shared allowance. Direct connections do not use it.
common.chat_files_too_large: This file exceeds the limit for this connection. Use a direct connection or split the file.
common.chat_files_import_failed: %1$@ could not be imported. Choose a non-empty file up to 256 MB.
common.chat_files_busy: Finish or cancel the current file transfer first.
common.chat_files_remaining: About %1$@ of relay allowance remains. The server checks the allowance throughout the transfer.
common.chat_route_throttle: Use fallbacks for temporary rate limits
common.chat_route_errors: Use fallbacks when a provider is unavailable
common.chat_route_notify: Notify me about limits and routing errors
common.chat_route_preferred: Preferred: {0}. Returns on the next turn after reset.
common.chat_route_empty_history: Limits, switches and errors will appear here.
common.chat_route_policy_help: Fallbacks keep the same task and permissions. Each destination is tried once. If none works, the chat pauses. Unknown delivery always needs review.
common.chat_route_permissions: This agent cannot keep this chat’s approval settings and will be skipped.
common.chat_route_auth: Use fallbacks when an agent needs sign-in
common.chat_route_agent_errors: Use fallbacks if an agent turn fails
common.chat_route_load_failed: Routing settings could not be loaded. Try again.
common.chat_route_wait_mode: Wait and continue with the same model
common.chat_route_combined_mode: Try fallbacks first, then wait for a reported reset
common.chat_route_priority_help: Fallbacks are tried first. Waiting resumes an agent only after its reported reset. Returning to the preferred model happens on the next turn and never interrupts active work.
common.chat_routing_intro: Choose what happens when an agent reaches a limit.
common.chat.command.unsupported: Native compaction is available for Claude and Codex. Other agents manage context automatically.
common.chat.command.idle: Wait for the current turn to finish before compacting.
common.chat.command.no_attachments: Remove attachments before using a chat command.
common.chat.command.no_arguments: Choose a command from the list. These commands do not take arguments.
common.chat.stats.no_data: This agent has not reported context usage.
common.chat.stats.partial: The reported inventory is partial. Counts cover listed tools.
common.chat.stats.unavailable: Update or reconnect the host to view chat statistics.
common.chat.stats.no_servers: No MCP servers reported or configured.
common.chat.stats.catalog_window: Context limit from the model catalog.
common.chat.steer_help: Adds context to the current turn without stopping it.
common.chat.images.save_failed: The image could not be saved.
common.chat.stats.last_window: Context limit from the last report for this model.
common.chat.activity.title: Activity
common.chat.activity.unavailable: Activity is not available from this host.
common.chat.activity.partial: Some activity may not have been reported.
common.chat.activity.command_goal: View the reported goal and its progress
common.chat.activity.command_plan: View the reported plan and step status
common.chat.activity.command_subagents: View reported subagents and their status
common.new_chat.title: What will you build?
common.new_chat.subtitle: Start with a repository. Take it somewhere new.
common.new_chat.empty: Add a folder to start your first conversation.
common.chat.detail.minimal_help: Every reply stays visible. Thinking and tool steps fold between replies. Approvals, failures and handoffs always show.
common.chat.detail.compact_help: Every step is one quiet line, like "Edited ChatView.swift +6 −2". Open a line to see its output or diff. Approvals, failures and handoffs always show.
common.chat.detail.standard_help: Thinking and runs of reads and searches fold to one line each. Commands and edits keep their own rows.
common.chat.detail.detailed_help: Every step on its own row, with its output open.
common.chat.inspector.allowed_help: Always allow on a permission card remembers tools and commands here.
common.new_chat.setup_changed: This agent or model is no longer available. Choose again.
common.session_identity.title: Session IDs
common.session_identity.not_reported: No agent session ID reported yet.
common.session_identity.history_help: Previous IDs can help locate transcripts. They may no longer resume.
